      • reset

        public void reset()
        Resets and recomputes occurences of this task based on the rule(). This will potentially reset the next(boolean) occurence.
        See Also:

      • next

        public java.time.ZonedDateTime next​(boolean future)
        Returns the closest next occurence of this task as defined by rule().

        The next occurence might be in the past, meaning it is past due and should run asap.

        The next occurence may also be null which indicates that there are no further occurences at this time.

        Parameters:
        future - if true, the next occurence should be computed in the future from now. If false, it should not move ahead to the next future occurence and may return a previousely computed occurence
        Returns:
        the next occurence of this task or null if there are no next occurences
